tools.name: create_short_link
tools.description: Create a new Flyn short link that redirects to a destination URL. Returns the link id, slug, and full short URL. The destination is scanned with Google Safe Browsing before creation. Free accounts can create 25 links per calendar month; password protection, click limits, fallback URLs, weighted rota

tools.name: list_links
tools.description: List the account's short links with pagination, search, and filtering. Returns each link's id, slug, short URL, destination, click count, and settings, plus its conversion counters: conversionTracking (whether the link carries a click id), conversions, and conversionValueCents (total value reported

tools.name: get_link
tools.description: Fetch one short link by its id, including destination, settings, total click count, and its conversion counters (conversionTracking, conversions, conversionValueCents).

tools.name: update_link
tools.description: Update an existing short link. Can re-point the destination URL without changing the printed/shared short link, plus edit title, slug, tags, expiration, rotation destinations, and Pro settings. Only the provided fields are changed.

tools.name: delete_link
tools.description: Permanently delete a short link. The short URL immediately stops redirecting and this cannot be undone.

tools.name: get_link_analytics
tools.description: Fetch click events for a short link, newest first. Every plan sees timestamps and total counts; country, city, device, OS, browser, and referrer detail requires Flyn Pro (fields are null on the free plan). Free plans see the last 30 days of history. tools.name: get_link_qr_code
tools.description: Render a scannable QR code for an existing Flyn short link. Because the code encodes the short link rather than the destination, you can repoint the link later and every printed code follows, and each scan is counted as a click. The image is returned as a PNG you can look at. Custom colours and SVG

tools.name: create_qr_code
tools.description: Render a QR code for any of seven content types: a link, plain text, WiFi credentials, a v-card contact, a pre-filled email, a phone number, or a pre-filled SMS. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_links · Private data: create_short_link, create_qr_code · Public sink: create_qr_code · Destructive: delete_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_links · Private data: create_short_link, create_qr_code · Public sink: create_qr_code · Destructive: delete_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
